name: @playform/client-dsh-panel-family-host
description: The host half of the UI family's panel: the small companion package that gives the central panel LIVE data (Documentation/Plans/UI-Family/PHASE-5-ADAPTERS-AND-LEDGER-TAILS.md - the family-host Typert remote endpoint). Two methods, least privilege, READ-ONLY: tail(namespace, lines) returns the last N lines of the owning module's ~/.dsh log (the family ledger tails), and stats() returns the CCR store stats; the fiberPhases come from the already-remote remote.pluginManager, so no new endpoint is added for them (PHASE-5 step 1: prefer the existing remote). The endpoint reads ~/.dsh family logs ONLY and has no write surface (A5.3). The Typert generation pipeline (TypertRemoteService + @Remote + generated descriptors) is documented as not reproducible from an external package (PHASE-5 caveat), so the PoC ships the endpoint as a plain host service under the name panelFamilyHost with the exact method surface tail(namespace, lines) and stats(); the end-phase decides between reproducing the generation pipeline and keeping the v1 shortcut (the pre-decided fallback: expose only existing remote namespaces, ledgers via this service).
